recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抽吸抹片以血液為主、有核細胞稀少，但可見兩顆大型多核細胞，許多圓形核聚成一團、核彼此分開不重疊，符合破骨細胞（osteoclast），反映腎性骨病變中骨吸收增加。
features: Two large multinucleated cells with numerous discrete, round, uniform nuclei clustered together
Nuclei are separate rather than overlapping or lobulated, favoring osteoclasts over megakaryocytes
Moderate amount of pale purple cytoplasm surrounding the nuclear clusters
Hemodilute background with abundant red cells and sparse scattered nucleated cells
describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hemodilute specimen with abundant red cells and sparse nucleated hematopoietic cells. Two large multinucleated cells are present, each containing numerous discrete, uniform, round nuclei within a moderate amount of pale purple cytoplasm. The separate, non-overlapping nuclei favor osteoclasts over megakaryocytes. Cellular detail is limited at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of increased osteoclasts, compatible with increased bone resorption as in renal osteodystrophy.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single multilobated, overlapping nucleus with granular cytoplasm, whereas osteoclasts have many separate, uniform round nuclei.
Tumor clusters consist of individual cohesive cells with their own cell borders and nuclear pleomorphism rather than one shared cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Multinucleated giant cells of granulomatous disease
ddx.vs: Langhans or foreign-body giant cells occur with epithelioid histiocytes and have peripherally arranged nuclei, which requires biopsy correlation.
